protocol.purpose: source-coordinate cross-fitting; same historical forest screening

original_protocol.purpose: historical expression screening; no development or final targets
original_protocol.teacher_scope: each source forest uses that source only; own source excluded from replay inputs
original_protocol.screening: source response R128 strictly higher, N128 and discovery AUC no lower than both controls; at least two positive historical lineages versus each control

protocol.fold_rule: five shuffled KFold splits, seed 1301; common coordinate indices for all sources
protocol.source_training_scope: each prediction excludes its entire coordinate fold; own system excluded from inputs
protocol.screening: source response R128 strictly higher, N128 and discovery AUC no lower than both controls; at least two positive historical lineages versus each control
